page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-highmem-64 is a memory-optimized server instance powered by the ARMv8 architecture. It features 64 dedicated physical cores utilizing the Neoverse-V2 CPU model running at 3.0 GHz, with one thread per core. The hardware configuration includes 512.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per core. The processor is equipped with 64 KB L1d cache, 2 MB L2 cache, and 80 MB L3 cache. This instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance. The server achieves top-tier results in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, Geekbench multi-core scores, and software compilation using Clang. Memory subsystem performance is highly efficient, with top-tier Passmark memory scores and cached read-only small block bandwidth reaching 7912.04 GB/sec. Database operations and Redis SET operations also rank in the top tier, alongside static web serving throughput. Single-core performance and text processing benchmarks fall within the average range.

Utilizing the ARM-based Neoverse-V2 architecture allows this instance to deliver high resource density and power efficiency. The 1:8 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes it a cost-effective choice for memory-intensive deployments without the overhead of x86 licensing. This server is highly suited for database hosting, Redis caching layers, software compilation pipelines, static web serving at scale, and memory-bound multi-threaded applications.
